evidenceItems.title: QApilot MCP for Android
evidenceItems.summary: Android app testing inside your coding agent - QApilot MCP automates tests on real Android devices and emulators by talking to Claude, Cursor or Codex. Describe a test flow in plain English, no Appium code required. Your agent lays out the steps. QApilot runs the steps. Every pass saves a Gherkin feature file and becomes a replayable test case. Needs Node, Java and the Android SDK.
